Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (September 7, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Proposal Ariba Document Number 3988526049 Description: For the provision of Custodian Services of housekeeping and laundry workers to Seniors Services and Long-Term Care homes. Should the option be exercised, then the General Manager of Seniors Services and Long-Term Care Division or designate will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
